title: building-ai-readiness: code, results and supplement for a measurement-based AI-readiness assessment of buildings
description: Reproduction repository of the paper "Which Buildings Are Artificial Intelligence-Ready? A Measurement-Based Assessment Framework for AI Question Answering and Actuation". It contains the readiness canon, the ceiling census, the question bank, the agent harness and grader (code, Apache-2.0); the deposited run summaries, episode transcripts, tables, census and ceilings (results/, CC BY-NC 4.0); and the BATS v1.0 L3 supplement, two separating streams and two paired fault scenarios for the Tampa large office (supplement/, CC BY-NC 4.0). Three reproduction levels: the run tables from the deposited summaries; the census and ceilings from the public data (BATS v1.0, Mortar, BTS); and an agent smoke run with a local open model. BATS v1.0 itself is not redistributed; scripts/fetch_data.py downloads it.
notes: Folder licenses: code (bara/, scripts/, tests/) Apache-2.0 (LICENSE); results/ CC BY-NC 4.0 (results/LICENSE); supplement/ (data, merge script, README) CC BY-NC 4.0 (supplement/LICENSE); bara/brick/Brick.ttl BSD-3-Clause (Brick Consortium).
